items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude claim-document translation. The police report is required under 2.3.3, but neither of the two billed hours is covered.
Clauses 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude the provider’s working materials and ancillary charges associated with claim-document translation.

The watch was taken in a covered robbery under 2.3.1–2.3.2. Clause 7.1.9 limits valuation to a like-for-like watch, then 4.4 caps it at €2,500; allocating the single €150 event deductible proportionally across the €3,000 covered loss leaves €2,375 on this line.
The roughly €900 nominal cash loss is capped at €500 under 2.3.2 and 4.2.3. This line’s proportional share of the single €150 event deductible is €25, leaving €475.
The sunglasses were mislaid later, not taken in the robbery. Clauses 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.5 exclude them even though they appear on the same settlement statement.
Clauses 7.1.8(b) and 5.2.3 exclude shipping for replacement property or claim documents, even when billed alongside covered property.
